violations.description: Development and production dependencies are not separated
violations.evidence: requirements.txt contains both runtime and development packages (pytest, httpx) without a separate requirements-dev.txt or dev extras in pyproject.toml
violations.recommendation: Separate runtime dependencies from development dependencies using requirements-dev.txt or [project.optional-dependencies] in pyproject.toml

violations.description: CI workflow does not pin action versions to a commit SHA
violations.evidence: actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-python@v5 use mutable version tags rather than immutable commit SHAs, which can introduce supply-chain risk
violations.recommendation: Pin third-party GitHub Actions to a specific commit SHA (e.g., actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683)

violations.description: .gitignore does not exclude common IDE configuration directories
violations.evidence: .gitignore is present but missing entries for .idea/ (JetBrains) and .vscode/ (VS Code)
violations.recommendation: Add .idea/ and .vscode/ (or .vscode/settings.json) to .gitignore to avoid committing IDE-specific files
